facts.activity_file: testing for dead and applying earths

consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: earth leakage and protection setting integrity
authorisation of switching and access to apparatus

facts.title: residual pressure found after isolation of SG-7000

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control EARTH_LEAKAGE_PROTECTION: the earth leakage and protection setting integrity was in place but did not perform, and the accident investigation classified this as an individual or team action.
Control SWITCHING_AUTHORISATION: the authorisation of switching and access to apparatus was not in place, and the accident investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next spot check that the earth leakage and protection setting integrity on SG-7000 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling access to energised apparatus, specifically testing for dead and applying earths. SG-7000 (terminal switchgear) is in service for terminal distribution. The task proceeded during routine operation while the earth leakage and protection setting integrity was in place but did not perform. The electrical energy involved is held as HV switchgear, and the recorded presentation was shock, arc flash, unplanned energisation.
response.summary: On 7 January 2008 a near hit was recorded on SG-7000 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during routine operation; electrical energy held as HV switchgear was not released.
